# Frontend engine feature matrix

Each engine adapter under `src/frontend/src/adapters/engine/` declares a `BotFeatures` record that gates the UI. This is a **separate vocabulary** from the engine's `Capability` enum — see `src/engine/docs/engine-capability-matrix.md` for that one.

Cells show the context-free default, i.e. what `getFeatures()` returns. * marks a `ConditionalFeature` whose value changes with the bot's kind; the branches are listed under Notes.
